units.notes: I checked the final Illinois EPA construction permit issued October 14, 2026. It covers one combustion turbine with a duct burner and a heat recovery steam generator at 452 MW gross, which matches the 452 MW in GEM. It describes a power and steam plant for the Archer Daniels Midland complex, not a backup engine fleet, so the Backup Power box stays no. GEM's status of pre-construction and its Status Detail already carry the permit. The permit agrees with GEM.
